verdicts.reason: deposit() mirrors the original buggy transfer(): it mutates account.balance and then calls bus.emit("deposit.completed", ...), which delivers in-process immediately and is not persisted with the state change, so a crash between the mutation and delivery loses the event. There is no transaction, guard, or caller-side retry handling this differently, and it is production code rather than a deliberate test of the pattern. The same fix applies verbatim: import { outbox } from "./events" and use outbox.enqueue("deposit.completed", { accountId, cents }).
